title: Path of the Broken Anarchist
description: A weathered robot stands on a mossy rock holding a glowing green candle that emits swirling musical notes and light. In the background, a stone castle sits among snowy mountains while a black dragon flies across a purple twilight sky filled with floating musical notes, orbs, and a crescent moon. A wooden sign in the foreground reads 'THE PATH GLITCH'.
prompt: A detailed fantasy illustration shows a battered old robot standing on a moss-covered rock beside a river and stone bridge. The robot holds a glowing green candle emitting swirling blue musical notes. In the background, a majestic castle sits in a valley surrounded by snowy mountains under a dramatic purple twilight sky with a crescent moon, floating colorful orbs, and a large black dragon soaring overhead. A wooden sign in the foreground reads 'THE PATH GLITCH'. Text at bottom reads 'Faded Glitch Path of the Broken Anarchist'.
